text: Create vector graphics and interface art directly in the editor
quote: Create vector graphics, responsive layouts, and reusable components, or import images, audio, fonts, and other assets from your favorite design tools.

text: Build layouts that respond and resize responsively
quote: Create vector graphics, responsive layouts, and reusable components, or import images, audio, fonts, and other assets from your favorite design tools.

text: Create reusable components; instances stay linked and update when the source changes
quote: Create a component once, then use customized instances of it throughout your Rive file. Changes made to the source component are reflected across all of its instances.

text: Import images, audio, fonts, and other assets from external design tools
quote: import images, audio, fonts, and other assets from your favorite design tools

text: Animate designs with timelines, keyframes, and smooth interpolation
quote: Bring your designs to life with timelines, keyframes, and smooth interpolation.

text: Build interactive experiences that react to user input, screen size, scrolling, and app state
quote: Build interactive experiences that respond to user input, screen size, scrolling, and application state.

text: Bind animation properties (position, color, layout) to real-time data with two-way sync
quote: When data changes, your scene updates automatically. Likewise, changes made in your scene can be written back to your data.

text: Use scripting to create custom procedural animations and behaviors beyond built-in tools
quote: Use scripting to create custom interactions, procedural animation, and behaviors that go beyond the built-in tools.

text: Export a single file and run it across web, mobile, game engines, and other platforms
quote: You can use the same exported file across supported runtimes, including web, mobile, game engines, and other platforms.

text: Built-in AI agent writes code, designs layouts, and generates animation
quote: Rive's AI agent helps you write code, design, and animate. Generate scripts, responsive layouts, data models, and even animation.

text: AI automates repetitive tasks like building complex state machines, view models, and layouts
quote: The first set of tools are designed to let AI handle repetitive tasks, like creating complex View Models, State Machines with hundreds of states/layers, Layouts, Shapes, and more.

text: Auto-saves work continuously and tracks all changes across collaborators
quote: Rive saves your files automatically as you work. Even if multiple people are working on the same file at the same time, Rive tracks all changes and stores them in the Revision History.

text: Non-destructive revision history lets you restore any previous file version
quote: This guarantees that even restoring revisions is non-destructive, and you can always go back to the previous version of the file.

text: Rive Markup Language (RML) lets you create/modify Rive files as text/code, enabling agent-driven workflows
quote: Rive Markup Language (RML) is a text-based representation of a Rive file. It lets you create and modify Rive content as code

text: Cache a loaded .riv file in memory for reuse across multiple instances
quote: Caching a Rive file: Load the .riv into memory once, use it multiple times.

text: Connect the Rive Editor to AI tools via MCP
quote: You can connect the Rive Editor to AI tools through MCP (Model Context Protocol).

text: Design, animate, and code in one place — what you build ships directly with no separate handoff step
quote: Design, animate, and code in one place. What you build in the editor is what ships in your app, game, or website. No mockups, no prototypes, no handoff.

text: Rive runtimes are open-source libraries for loading and controlling animations in apps
quote: The Rive runtimes are open-source libraries that allow you to load and control your animations in apps, games, and websites.

text: Runtime library loads .riv files, advances state machines/animations, and renders via an abstract renderer interface
quote: Loads .riv files, advances state machines and animations, and draws via the abstract Renderer interface.

text: Built-in GPU renderer supports Metal, Vulkan, D3D11, D3D12, and OpenGL/WebGL backends
quote: The built-in GPU renderer (RiveRenderer) has RenderContextImpl backends for Metal, Vulkan, D3D11, D3D12, and OpenGL/WebGL.

text: Build interactive UI/motion/game experiences in the Editor or generate them via an agent using the CLI
quote: Build interactive UI, motion, and game experiences in the Editor, or let an agent generate them with the CLI.
